description:
Astrid Engberg’s Oasis off her debut album Tulpa receives a vivid re-imagination by acclaimed french producer Neue Grafik (22a, Rhythm Section, CoOp). Effortlessly transforming Astrid’s enchanting voice and subtle ambient jazz piece into a futuristic, bass-heavy stepper. 

Neue Grafik is an esteemed, instrumentalist and DJ closely connected to the Parisian (his hometown) and London jazz scenes having previously released on highly respected labels 22a (Henry Wu, Al Dobson Jr.) and Rhythm Section (Chaos In The CBD, Dan Kye, Wayne Snow).
